chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Bundar, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Eating the fish melts the body.
ai.seo_question: What is the effect of eating fish on the body according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) notes that consuming fish 'melts' or weakens the body, a concept often interpreted by Shia scholars as either a literal reduction in bodily strength or a metaphorical softening of resolve. This ruling is situated within the broader chapter on fish (*Al-Hut*), where scholars debate whether this refers to specific types of fish or a general dietary caution, reflecting the practical medical and spiritual concerns of the early Shia community.
